content.title: Champions League recap: Bayern Munich 4-3 Real Madrid
content.text: 22:08CHAMPIONS LEAGUE SEMI-FINALS PSG v Bayern MunichAtletico Madrid v Arsenal There's our last four. One team who won their first title last year, two have never won it and another seeking a seventh European Cup in their illustrious history. You can tune into highlights from tonight's Arsenal-Sporting game in the Emirates - albeit a goalless highlights package (can only work with what's given). Highlights will be uploaded onto Youtube later on. Reports and reaction to come. Thanks for following. 22:04The Olise goal that rounded off the victory for the hosts — RTÉ Sport (@RTEsport) April 15, 202622:03The late goals that sealed it for Bayern — RTÉ Sport (@RTEsport) April 15, 202621:58GOAL: Michael Olise Full-time: Bayern Munich 4-3 Real Madrid (6-4)Bayern finish with a flourish. The kind of flourish that an engrossing game deserved. Michael Olise completing a counter by cutting in from the right and clipping a slightly lofted shot past Lunin and in off the far post. The Real players are crowding the Slovenian referee, with Bellingham and Vini Jr especially irate. Arda Guler sprang from the bench to make his feelings known, receiving a red card after the final whistle for his trouble. The red card shown some minutes before the final whistle was a key moment, Camavinga being sent off when the game was still level on aggregate. 21:53Full-time: Arsenal 0-0 Sporting (1-0 agg)Arsenal survive after a jittery display but they're into the semi-final of the Champions League for a second successive year. Kai Havertz's injury-time goal proved sufficient. The performance will offer more ammunition to their critics and their form is faltering badly on the run-in. But they're still, as it stands, on track for a tilt at the double. 21:5294 mins: Arsenal 0-0 Sporting CP (1-0)Anguish from the Sporting fans as their last shot flashes into the side-netting. Simoes had the final effort. 21:50GOAL: Luis Diaz 88 mins: Bayern Munich 3-3 Real Madrid (5-4)Is that it? Beautifully worked, patient goal. With the man advantage, Bayern thread passes around in the final third. The ball is shifted to Diaz on the left edge of the penalty area. He poked a pass inside to Musiala, who back-heeled quickly back to him, creating an extra second of space for the shot. Diaz unfurled a shot, which may have taken a hint of a deflection which helped him past Lunin. 21:48RED CARD: Eduardo Camavinga 86 mins: Bayern Munich 2-3 Real Madrid (4-4)There's been an incredible spate of yellow cards and now we have our first red. He initially fouled Kane, which was an innocuous enough. However, he then picked the ball up and was slow in giving it back to Kimmich, who reacted. It enraged the ref also, who blew his whistle furiously and dispensed a yellow card. Big advantage to Munich now, for the remainder of the game and the possible extra-time. 21:4684 mins: Bayern Munich 2-3 Real Madrid (4-4)Heartstopping moment as Upamecano, facing his own goal, miscontrols a dropping ball, allowing Vinicius Jr to take possession and run to towards the end-line. The French defender gets across to block the cut-back and then shepherds the Brazilian out to the sideline. He fixed his own mistake in the end. 21:4384 mins: Arsenal 0-0 Sporting CP (1-0)Probably the closest Arsenal have come as a Trossard header comes back off the near post. A moment later, Jesus races up the end-line but his side-footed shot is fired into the side-netting. More stories on Read Next
